macros.name: liningnums
macros.doc: Commands \oldstylenums{...} and \liningnums{...} are defined to allow for local use of old-style figures or lining figures, respectively.

macros.name: proportionalnums
macros.doc: \tabularnums{...} and \proportionalnums{...} allow for local use of monospaced or varying-width figures, respectively.

macros.name: tabularnums
macros.doc: \tabularnums{...} and \proportionalnums{...} allow for local use of monospaced or varying-width figures, respectively.
